text:
maria-cs: Heads up — OrchidAI submitted a request to onboard a domain-tuned 13B. Key asks: robust PHI redaction, hallucination detection, and a perf target. Renewal touchpoint in ~60 days so timeline matters.

jake-se: Do we have their sample bundle yet? I can run a compatibility pass and baseline eval.

maria-cs: They uploaded a private S3 bundle (~2.2GB). Requirements recap: 1) Safety: token-level PHI redaction + entity-based abstain. 2) Eval: QA accuracy, hallucination scoring, entity recall. 3) Perf: p95 <=200ms single-turn @512 tokens (customer expectation). Also asked for a short runbook and Hosted vs Dedicated cost delta.

oliver-security: PHI handling is a blocker for Private/HSM. Need: redaction spec, dataflow diagram, and KMS key policy before we enable. Also we should confirm minimal engineer access matrix. @maria-cs can you request those items?

sophia-prod: 200ms p95 on a 13B is tight but possible with INT8 quant + KV caching. Realistic initial baseline ~350ms p95; optimized path might reach ~220ms with tuned kernels and prefix caching. Ill draft an ops config (autoscale, batching) and cost notes.

jake-se: I'll scaffold an eval harness tomorrow. Quick command I'll run locally: 

```
python eval_runner.py --model orchidai-13b --dataset s3://orchidai/samples/testset.jsonl \n  --checks hallucination,qa-score,entity-recall \n  --output /tmp/orchid_eval.json
```

maria-cs: Sent DM with S3 link. Customer insists on at least one explicit abstain example containing PHI that must be redacted/abstained. They also want a few failure-case examples captured.

sophia-prod: I'll add an "abstain" hook to the eval config and a small prompt-set for stress tests. Example rule well validate: 

```
if entities.intersection(['SSN','PHI','MED_REC']):
    return 'ABSTAIN: contains sensitive PII/PHI'
else:
    return generate_response()
```

oliver-security: Filing legal checkpoint: if they request HSM for production keys, need contract language and SOC docs. Also marking renewal risk: if timeline slips >=30 days they may postpone renewal. Recommend labeling task as time-sensitive in CS playbook.

maria-cs: I'll pull redaction spec and KMS policy from the customer and update the ticket. Adding account-health note: successful onboard within 30 days = positive renewal signal (+15% likelihood).

deploy-bot: New ticket created: ORCHIDAI-2027 "Onboard orchidai-13b domain model - PHI redaction & eval" assigned to jake-se, due 2024-12-12.

jake-se: I'll run a small subset tomorrow and post perf baseline + suggested quant profile. Will include abstain test outcomes. Anything else to add?

maria-cs: Capture the following in the runbook: 1) abstain test case examples, 2) hallucination scoring method (precision/recall thresholds), 3) Hosted vs Dedicated cost table, 4) HSM access checklist. I'll escalate legal ask once I have KMS policy.

sophia-prod: Added TODOs: cost delta table + expected token/unit economics for expected workload. Sharing draft EOD.

maria-cs: Thanks all — tagging renewal owner once we get first eval and perf baseline.
